Skill / Competence Area Specification Input by Service Provider [Please note: Simple Yes or No responses are not sufficient] Mandatory / Preferred / Desirable Minimum years of experience 5 years in auditing experience. The candidate has over 7.5 years of experience. M University Qualifications Mandatory - A bachelor’s degree Bachelor’s degree in commerce M University Qualifications A bachelor’s degree in business administration /finance for Category 1 - General Auditor Chartered Accountancy (CA) Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, 2022 Bachelor of Commerce - Bangalore University, Bengaluru, 2013 M Professional Qualifications Preferable - Auditing certification is beneficial. CA, Chartered Accountancy, ICAI, 2022 P Professional Qualifications Desirable - Valid membership of a relevant professional body (e.g. The Institute of Internal Auditors) Include a list of relevant courses attended. Institute of Chartered Accountants of India D Experience Areas Prior experience in Business / Finance Audit in the Energy Sector for Category 1 The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: P

General Auditor: Governance Risk Management Corporate	Strategic	Planning and Performance Management Finance Human Resources Procurement and Contracts Prior experience in Engineering Audit in the Energy Sector for Category 2 The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: Technical Auditor: Supply	Chain	and	Materials Management Inventory and Warehouse Production and Operations Process Safety Maintenance Asset Integrity Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Engineering Management Measurement and Metering Laboratory Operations Investments	and	Project Management Behavioral Good judgment and analytical skills (big picture) Please provide examples. During an audit of a solar energy client, the candidate identified unexplained variances in inventory reports related to solar panels and inverters. Leveraging SAP data and Excel trend analysis, the candidate uncovered over-reporting caused by manual consolidation errors across warehouses. The Candidate recommended an automated reconciliation tracker, which improved inventory accuracy and enhanced reporting reliability. During an audit of a hospitality group, the candidate identified inconsistencies in POS revenue and cash handling. Instead of escalating prematurely, the candidate used Excel-based reconciliation and trend comparison across outlets. His findings led to improved oversight controls and the implementation of standardized cash-handling SOPs across the chain. M

Behavioral Strong organizational skills (scheduling meetings, adequate and timely working papers). Please elaborate / provide examples. The candidate displayed excellent organizational skills while managing 30 walkthrough meetings within 3 months during peak audit season. Despite stakeholders’ limited availability, the candidate proactively scheduled sessions across global time zones, ensured timely follow-ups, and coordinated with process owners efficiently. The Candidate also prepared and circulated detailed meeting minutes, completed walkthrough checklists, and maintained audit documentation aligned with internal quality standards. His structured approach ensured that all walkthroughs were completed on time without compromising audit quality. While working with multiple clients simultaneously, the candidate demonstrated strong time and task management by organizing audit planning, execution, and documentation without delays. The Candidate ensured timely preparation and review of working papers, maintained version control and adhered to internal review timelines, which helped avoid last-minute escalations during external reviews. M Behavioral Ability to work independently with minimum instructions and supervision from the Lead Auditor. Has (s)he led many assignments before? Size of assignments that were led. The candidate has consistently demonstrated the ability to work independently with minimal supervision. The Candidate has successfully led multiple internal audits and SOX assignments across industries such as logistics, renewable energy, hospitality, and exports. The Candidate managed end-to-end engagements—from planning and walkthroughs to fieldwork, documentation, and reporting—for assignments covering 8 to 12 key business processes. His leadership included managing testing activities, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality audit deliverables without significant oversight. The candidate independently managed end-to-end SOX testing for 40–50 controls across key business cycles, including PTP, OTC, Inventory, and Payroll. The Candidate conducted walkthroughs, performed control testing, documented results, and followed up on exceptions with minimal supervision. Through proactive planning and disciplined execution, the candidate consistently met corporate deadlines and often completed deliverables well ahead of schedule. M Competence Very good expertise in Data Analytics techniques. Please	provide	details/examples	of expertise. The candidate has strong expertise in data analytics, with hands-on experience using Excel (including Power Query, Pivot Tables), SAP ERP, and Alteryx for audit and compliance testing. The Candidate has used these tools to automate control testing, perform trend and exception analysis, and validate large datasets across functions like PTP, OTC, Inventory, and Payroll. For example, the candidate used Alteryx to identify duplicate vendor payments during SOX testing, which helped improve the process and mitigate risk. P Competence Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel Provide examples in support of response. The candidate possesses advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the use of Power Query, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, conditional formatting, data validation, and dynamic dashboards. The Candidate has used Excel extensively for audit sampling, exception reporting, trend analysis, and control testing. For example, the candidate automated a reconciliation template using Power Query to track inventory variances across multiple warehouse locations, significantly reducing manual effort and increasing accuracy in audit testing. P Competence Good knowledge and use of SAP ERP system The candidate has a strong working knowledge of the SAP ERP system, primarily using it for audit and control testing purposes. The Candidate has extracted and analyzed PTP, Inventory, and Fixed Assets data to perform walkthroughs, validate control effectiveness, and identify process gaps. For example, the candidate used SAP to review asset capitalization entries and depreciation runs during a fixed assets audit, identifying incorrect asset class mapping instances and improving financial reporting accuracy. P Communication Strong written and oral communication skills (in English). This includes the ability to prepare high quality Audit Memos with recommendations. Provide examples of types of reports prepared. The candidate has strong written and oral communication skills in English, demonstrated through preparing high-quality audit deliverables. The Candidate has drafted audit memos, risk and control matrices (RCMs), walkthrough documentation, and executive-level summary reports. His reports include clear issue descriptions, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations. For example, the candidate prepared detailed audit memos highlighting control gaps in PTP and Inventory processes, which were well-received by senior stakeholders and used to drive remediation actions. M Communication Excellent interpersonal and interviewing skills, including the ability to interact with all levels of management and employees. Provide examples of levels of management and employees that have been interacted with in the past. The candidate has excellent interpersonal and interviewing skills, demonstrated through regular interactions with stakeholders across various levels—from junior staff to senior management. The Candidate has conducted control walkthroughs, process interviews, and follow-up discussions professionally and collaboratively. For example, during a large-scale SOX assignment, the candidate independently led over 30 walkthrough meetings across departments, built a strong rapport with process owners, and was able to extract key insights critical to evaluating control design and effectiveness. M

Curriculum Vitae Name:  Mohammed Javeed Education: Bachelor of Commerce - Bangalore University Professional Certification: Chartered Accountancy (CA), Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, 2022 Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada, and Urdu PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Company- Senior Lead – Internal Audit & SOX, Grant Thornton INDUS Date: October 2024-December 2024 Country: India Spearheaded independent audit assignments for global clients, focusing on critical supply chain and logistics operations. Evaluated internal controls and operational risks for material handling, dispatch scheduling, and inventory logistics. Applied data analytics using SAP ERP and Excel to validate the accuracy of process records and support audit conclusions. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to understand workflows and design practical, control-focused recommendations. Prepared audit documentation, including risk matrices, narratives, and executive-level memos, in line with regulatory standards. Company- Senior Associate – SOX & CCAP, JP Morgan Chase & Co Date: May 2023-July 2024 Country: India Performed end-to-end SOX 404 testing and CCAP controls assessment for financial reporting processes across PTP, OTC, Inventory, and Payroll functions. Conducted control walkthroughs, evaluated design and operating effectiveness, and collaborated on remediation plans for identified gaps. Prepared narratives, RCMs, and control documentation aligned with COSO framework. Utilized Alteryx to automate audit procedures, extract patterns, and perform exception analysis in large datasets. Worked closely with internal stakeholders and control owners to ensure continuous improvement and compliance alignment. Company- Audit and Finance Manager, Bangalore Blues Entertainment India Private Limited Date: November 2022-April 2023 Country: India Led internal audits for a fast-growing hospitality chain, focusing on revenue assurance, vendor payments, and procurement controls. Designed and implemented control mechanisms to strengthen financial governance across outlets and central finance operations. Conducted cost analysis and identified opportunities for improving operational efficiency. Developed SOPs for finance processes and collaborated with operations teams to ensure process adherence. Utilized Excel and manual reconciliation to validate cash handling, POS billing, and inventory reporting. Company- Audit & Compliance Manager, R Vijayanand Chartered Accountant, Date: October 2017-November 2022 Country: India Conducted internal audits and SOX readiness for clients in the IT, hospitality, and energy sectors. Evaluated process controls and compliance over fuel inventory, dispatch tracking, storage facilities, and revenue recording within the energy sector. Reviewed financial statements, tested control environments, and provided risk mitigation suggestions tailored to industry-specific challenges. Drafted audit reports, maintained work papers, and supported external audit coordination across multiple engagements. Company- Audit & Compliance Manager, R Vijayanand Chartered Accountant, Date: October 2017-November 2022 Country: India Assisted in audits across hospitals, manufacturing, export, and banking industries. Conducted internal audit reviews of export companies, focusing on documentation controls, vendor payments, stock movements, and compliance with foreign trade regulations. Evaluated ICFR, prepared audit documentation, and supported compliance reviews.
